Quick Setup

Run the setup wizard

One command installs CogmemAi, configures Claude Code, and enables compaction recovery:

Terminal 
npx cogmemai-mcp setup

The wizard verifies your API key, adds the MCP server to Claude Code, and installs compaction recovery hooks in ~/.claude/settings.json.

Restart Claude Code after setup. Works in PowerShell, bash, zsh, and any terminal.
Manual setup (if you prefer not to use the wizard)

Step 1: Install

Terminal 
npm install -g cogmemai-mcp

Step 2: Configure

Per project — add .mcp.json to your project root:

.mcp.json 
{
  "mcpServers": {
    "cogmemai": {
      "command": "cogmemai-mcp",
      "env": {
        "COGMEMAI_API_KEY": "your_key_here"
      }
    }
  }
}

Or global — works in every project:

Terminal 
claude mcp add cogmemai cogmemai-mcp -e COGMEMAI_API_KEY=your_key_here --scope user

Manual setup does not install compaction recovery hooks. Run npx cogmemai-mcp setup afterward to add them.

Getting Started

Complete these steps to get the most out of CogmemAi.

Create an API key Generate your first key above. You'll need it for setup.
Run the setup wizard Run npx cogmemai-mcp setup in your terminal.
Save your first memory Start Claude Code and tell it something about your project. It will save a memory automatically.
Start a new session Open a fresh Claude Code session. Your memories load automatically — no re-explaining.

What’s New in CogmemAi

Intelligence Engine + Auto-Skills

CogmemAi gets smarter every time you use it. The Intelligence Engine is a self-improving memory system that learns what matters, connects related knowledge automatically, and synthesizes answers from your entire memory.

Self-Improving Recall
Useful memories rank higher automatically. Unused ones fade naturally.
Auto-Linking Knowledge Graph
Related memories connect automatically when you save them.
Contradiction Detection
Flags conflicting memories so you catch stale information.
Query Synthesis
Ask a question, get one coherent answer from all relevant memories.
Context-Aware Ranking
Debugging? Bug reports surface first. Planning? Architecture decisions lead.
Cross-Project Intelligence
Patterns in 3+ projects auto-promote to global scope.
Auto-Skills
Your corrections become behavioral rules. Correct once — it never happens again.
Closed-Loop Learning
Skills track their own confidence. They strengthen, adapt, or retire automatically.

Choose Your Storage Mode

CogmemAi now runs three ways. Switch modes anytime with npx cogmemai-mcp setup.

Cloud (Recommended)
Full Intelligence Engine. Semantic search, auto-skills, team collaboration, cross-device sync. This is the mode you’re using now.
Local
Zero-config, no API key needed. Basic keyword search. Great for air-gapped environments or trying CogmemAi instantly.
Hybrid
Local speed + cloud intelligence. Saves everywhere, falls back to local offline. Perfect for travel or unreliable networks.

REST API Reference

Base URL: https://hifriendbot.com/wp-json/hifriendbot/v1 — All endpoints require Authorization: Bearer cm_your_key

Core Memory

content required — The fact to remember (5-500 chars)
memory_type optional — identity, preference, architecture, decision, bug, dependency, pattern, context, session_summary, or any custom string
category optional — frontend, backend, database, devops, testing, security, performance, tooling, api, general
subject optional — What this memory is about (max 100 chars)
importance optional — 1-10 (default 5)
scope optional — global or project (default project)
project_id optional — Project identifier

Automatic deduplication: memories with >85% semantic similarity update the existing memory. Conflict detection for 65-84% similarity. Sensitive content (API keys, passwords) auto-flagged.

query required — Natural language search (2-500 chars)
limit optional — Max results, 1-20 (default 10)
memory_type optional — Filter by type
scope optional — global, project, or all
user_message required — The developer's message (1-4000 chars)
assistant_response optional — The assistant's response (max 4000 chars)
previous_context optional — Previous exchange for context (max 2000 chars)

Uses Ai to identify facts worth remembering from a conversation exchange. Counts against monthly extractions quota.

project_id optional — Project identifier
include_global optional — Include global memories (default true)
context optional — Current context for semantic ranking blend

Smart ranking: blends importance (40%), semantic relevance (40%), and recency (20%) when context is provided. Memory decay applied automatically.

memory_type optional — Filter by type
category optional — Filter by category
scope optional — global, project, or all
limit optional — Max results (default 50, max 100)
offset optional — Pagination offset
content optional — New content
importance optional — New importance (1-10)
scope optional — New scope

Previous version is saved to version history before updating. Sensitive content auto-detected on content changes.

Permanently deletes the memory and its embedding. This cannot be undone.

Returns memory count, extraction count, tier limits, project count, and current period stats.

Documents & Sessions

text required — Document text to process (up to 50K chars)
document_type optional — e.g. "README", "architecture doc", "meeting notes"
project_id optional — Project identifier

Splits text into ~2K chunks and extracts memories via Ai. Respects tier memory limits.

project_id optional — Project identifier (auto-detected from git)
trigger optional — "auto" or "manual" (default "auto")

Called by the PreCompact hook before context compaction. The companion UserPromptSubmit hook then calls /cogmemai/context on the next message to reload memories automatically.

summary required — Session summary text (up to 2K chars)
project_id optional — Project identifier

Stored as memory_type "session_summary" with importance 6. Auto-timestamped subject.

Import / Export / Versions

Returns JSON with version, timestamp, memory count, and full memory array. Use for backups or migration.

memories required — JSON string or array of memory objects

Validates each memory, applies deduplication, respects tier limits. Returns imported/skipped/error counts.

Returns chronological list of previous versions with content, importance, scope, change reason, and timestamp.

Team & Collaboration

project_id optional — Filter by project

Requires Team or Enterprise tier. Returns members with roles (owner, member, viewer).

email required — Email of the user to invite
project_id required — Project to share
role optional — member or viewer (default member)

Sensitive memories are excluded from team sharing. Requires Team or Enterprise tier.

Removes the specified team member. Auto-quarantines their team memories for 30 days. Only owners and admins can remove.

Lets a team owner or admin permanently delete a team-scoped memory authored by ANY team member (including poisoned content from removed users). Audit-logged. Default delete only allows the original author to delete.

limit optional — Max rows (default 100, capped at 500)

Returns recent team mutations: memory create/delete, member invite/accept/role-change/remove, seat assign/unassign. Owner/admin only. 90-day retention.

When you remove a team member their memories are auto-quarantined for 30 days. This restores them. Owner/admin only.

Hard-delete a removed member's quarantined memories before the 30-day timer fires. Irreversible. Owner/admin only.

Seat Licenses

Returns all active seat licenses owned by you, plus totals (total / assigned / available). WP login required.

email required — Verified email of the user to assign
team_id optional — Team to associate the seat with

Atomic claim — race-safe. Auto-provisions a CogmemAi API key for the assignee. Rejects unverified emails. WP login required.

Releases the seat for reassignment. The previous user loses CogmemAi access (their data is preserved). Does NOT cancel billing — the seat still counts toward your subscription.

Memory Relationships & Promotion

related_memory_id required — ID of the memory to link to
relationship_type required — led_to, contradicts, extends, or related

Returns all memories linked to this one, with relationship types and directions.

Finds memories with the same subject and type across 3+ projects. These are candidates for global promotion.

Changes a project-scoped memory to global scope, making it available in all projects. Version saved before promotion.
